# SPX Construction

> Utah residential general contractor building home additions, basement
> finishes, basement walkouts & entrances, egress windows, structural &
> concrete work, and garages along the Wasatch Front.

## About

SPX Construction is a licensed residential general contractor within a Utah
construction family with two decades of work on the Wasatch Front — a Spravek
company, alongside Alpine Fence & Deck and Harlow Landscapes. Concrete,
framing, and finish carpentry are self-performed; licensed trade partners run
mechanical, electrical, and plumbing under SPX supervision.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front
- Cities served: Salt Lake City, Lehi, Sandy, Draper, Alpine, Highland,
  Pleasant Grove, Provo, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Bountiful, Farmington,
  Park City, Heber City, Saratoga Springs
- Counties served: Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, Wasatch
- Price tier: mid-to-high residential ($$$)

## Capabilities

- Residential general contracting — permits, engineering, scheduling, inspections
- Home additions — main-level, second-story, and bump-out additions
- Basement finishing — bedrooms, baths, kitchens, theaters, rental suites
- Basement walkouts & entrances — foundation cuts, stairwells, areaways
- Egress windows — cuts, wells, and code-compliant window systems
- Structural & concrete — beam installs, wall removals, underpinning, flatwork
- Garages & detached structures — slab to roof

## Frequently asked

### Where does SPX Construction work?
Across Utah's Wasatch Front — Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, and Wasatch
counties.

### Do you handle permits and engineering?
Yes. Every structural scope carries stamped engineering, and every project is
permitted and inspected. SPX manages the full package.

### Can you add a separate basement entrance for a rental suite or ADU?
Yes. Basement walkouts and separate entrances are a core specialty — foundation
cut, shoring, excavation, retaining, drainage, stairwell, and door system,
engineered and permitted, where zoning allows.

### Are you part of a larger company?
Yes. SPX Construction is part of the Alpine Fence & Deck family of companies —
a Spravek company — twenty years of construction craft on the Wasatch Front,
under one accountability line.
